description: EDIT an existing clip from a plain instruction (video-to-video): the motion, timing, framing and cut stay, the named thing changes. 'change only the mug to red', 'make it nighttime', 'restyle it as claymation'. Your words are wrapped so the model keeps everything else identical, changes only what you named and repeats that lock; lighting is kept unless the change needs new light (set lighting to force either); literal:true sends your words as written. One change per call holds best. previewFirstFrame:true edits ONE still first (one image edit; previewAt picks the second) and quotes the clip; nothing else runs until you call again, ideally with previewStill. The reply scores how well the shot held outside the change (free) and flags an edit that touched more than asked. NOT for cuts/trims/end cards (post_edit), a new video (generate_video / render_ad), translation (dub_video) or a saved creator's face (recast_motion). Best on 3-15s clips.

elements.description: OPTIONAL identity/product grounding (≤4): a creator portrait or the real product photo, so the edit restores the REAL thing. Describe each one in the instruction

refs.description: up to 2 extra angles of the SAME subject

instruction.description: the change, in the user’s own words

interactionId.description: OPTIONAL: the interactionId an earlier Gemini Omni render or edit returned; the edit continues that clip on the same Omni model. If it cannot run, the video editor edits it and the reply says so.

keepAudio.description: default true: keep the source audio; false = silent

lighting.description: default auto: keep the source light unless the change needs new light (night, a lamp, fire). 'preserve' or 'relight' forces it

literal.description: true = send the instruction exactly as written, with no preserve/lock wrapper

previewAt.description: second to preview (default 0); resend with previewStill

previewFirstFrame.description: true = edit ONE still of the first frame first and quote the clip; the paid clip does not run

previewStill.description: the still a previewFirstFrame call returned; the clip then matches the changed thing to it

reference.description: OPTIONAL image URL that anchors the MATERIAL of what changes (a fabric, a finish, a colour swatch, the real product). Only its surface is used, never its framing or light

video.description: the source video URL (a render, job result or list_library)

name: edit_video
title: Edit a video clip
